title: Digi-Key Presents: Farm Different - Drones in Agriculture
speaker: DigiKey
zh: 【DigiKey】Digi-Key 推出：農場與眾不同 - 農業無人機（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: {Announcer] Digi-Key, Supplyframe, and Amphenol RF present, Farm different.
cues.en: {Announcer] Digi-Key, Supplyframe, and Amphenol RF present, Farm different.
cues.zh: Digi-Key、Supplyframe 與 Amphenol RF 共同呈現：農場大轉變。

cues.text: A three part series about people, technology and the challenges of modern agriculture.
cues.en: A three part series about people, technology and the challenges of modern agriculture.
cues.zh: 此係列影片共有三集，分別探討現代化農業的人力、科技與挑戰。

cues.text: Technology gonna change the world and the area industry including agriculture.
cues.en: Technology gonna change the world and the area industry including agriculture.
cues.zh: 此係列影片共有三集，分別探討現代化農業的人力、科技與挑戰。 科技將改變世界及航空產業，農業也包括在內。

cues.text: In this episode, we look at the rise of drones in Ag-Tech, replacing the Stick and Rudder on crop duster airplanes with a joystick and a screen.
cues.en: In this episode, we look at the rise of drones in Ag-Tech, replacing the Stick and Rudder on crop duster airplanes with a joystick and a screen.
cues.zh: 在本集影片，將探討無人機為何在農業科技中崛起，只要搖桿跟螢幕，就可取代灑農藥飛機上的操作桿與方向舵。

cues.text: Yeah, here we are in the America's Heartland, and you look at the agriculture and you know, I've pulsed people and said how is it transforming your life?
cues.en: Yeah, here we are in the America's Heartland, and you look at the agriculture and you know, I've pulsed people and said how is it transforming your life?
cues.zh: 我們在美國的中心地帶，到處都有農業發展。我問過人們，科技如何改變你的生活？

cues.text: And you could see in a couple of very evident ways, monitoring the fields, using drones, they're able to detect exactly how much insecticide or fertilizer or water needs to be applied for optimal crop growth.
cues.en: And you could see in a couple of very evident ways, monitoring the fields, using drones, they're able to detect exactly how much insecticide or fertilizer or water needs to be applied for optimal crop growth.
cues.zh: 你可看到不少明顯的例子，像是使用無人機來監測田野狀態，如此就可確實偵測殺蟲劑、肥料或水的用量，讓作物成長達到最佳狀態。

cues.text: The world's most recognizable drone maker, DJI headquartered in Shenzhen.
cues.en: The world's most recognizable drone maker, DJI headquartered in Shenzhen.
cues.zh: 全球最知名的無人機製造商 DJI，總部位於中國深圳。

cues.text: A global hub for hardware production, has made significant strides forward in the development of drone technology.
cues.en: A global hub for hardware production, has made significant strides forward in the development of drone technology.
cues.zh: 此處匯集了全球硬體生產資源，在無人機技術的開發上有長足的進步。

cues.text: DJI has a fleet of drones dedicated to the agriculture industry with a focus on turning everyday farmers into licensed pilots.
cues.en: DJI has a fleet of drones dedicated to the agriculture industry with a focus on turning everyday farmers into licensed pilots.
cues.zh: DJI 開發一系列農業專用的無人機，並著重於訓練實際務農者，成為有執照的無人機操作員。

cues.text: Ronnie Lu at DJI agriculture explains the importance of educating farmers on new drone technologies.
cues.en: Ronnie Lu at DJI agriculture explains the importance of educating farmers on new drone technologies.
cues.zh: Ronnie Lu 任職於 DJI 農業事業部，說明教育務農者瞭解無人機新技術的重要性。

cues.text: We also do this kind of pilot training, and we have this branch of Da jiang and then UTC academic, which provide training to our pilot, and in total we have trained more than 20,000 pilot worldwide.
cues.en: We also do this kind of pilot training, and we have this branch of Da jiang and then UTC academic, which provide training to our pilot, and in total we have trained more than 20,000 pilot worldwide.
cues.zh: 我們有提供無人機操作訓練，更設立專門部門與 UTC 學院，來提供操作人員訓練。目前全球有超過 2 萬名無人機操作員接受訓練。

cues.text: Drones replaced several outdated types of equipment bridging the gap between aerial and ground farm management by offering crop monitoring and precise protection solutions at lower costs.
cues.en: Drones replaced several outdated types of equipment bridging the gap between aerial and ground farm management by offering crop monitoring and precise protection solutions at lower costs.
cues.zh: 無人機可取代多種老舊裝置，串起農場空中與地面的管理，能以更低的成本，提供農作物監測與精準的防護方案。

cues.text: In less than half a year, digital agricultural drone pilot has provide drone spraying service for more than 6.7 million hectare farming world wide.
cues.en: In less than half a year, digital agricultural drone pilot has provide drone spraying service for more than 6.7 million hectare farming world wide.
cues.zh: 不到半年，農業無人機數位操作員就在全球超過 670 萬英畝的農田，以無人機實施噴灑服務。 Rex Sun 博士是農業工程專家，說明無人機技術如何大幅影響農業產業。

cues.text: Dr. Rex Sun, a PhD and professor in agricultural engineering, shares how drone technology can greatly impact the agriculture industry.
cues.en: Dr. Rex Sun, a PhD and professor in agricultural engineering, shares how drone technology can greatly impact the agriculture industry.
cues.zh: Rex Sun 博士是農業工程專家，說明無人機技術如何大幅影響農業產業。

cues.text: Drones is a great tool for future farmers for precision agriculture, to spot spray, also scouting, to scouting your farming, also to detect if there is any spot like a disease in your farming area, also creating the mapping for your farm.
cues.en: Drones is a great tool for future farmers for precision agriculture, to spot spray, also scouting, to scouting your farming, also to detect if there is any spot like a disease in your farming area, also creating the mapping for your farm.
cues.zh: 無人機對於未來農民來說是絕佳工具，可促成精密農業、點狀噴灑、農田巡視，也可偵測農場，是否有任何疾病的徵象，還可以繪製農場圖面。

cues.text: Drone technology I see is have some very beneficial points for the future farmers.
cues.en: Drone technology I see is have some very beneficial points for the future farmers.
cues.zh: 我認為無人機技術，能為未來農民帶來不少益處。

cues.text: According to estimates from the association of unmanned vehicle systems, farms will eventually account for 80% of the drone market worldwide.
cues.en: According to estimates from the association of unmanned vehicle systems, farms will eventually account for 80% of the drone market worldwide.
cues.zh: 根據無人機系統協會的估計，農業用途最終將佔全球無人機市場的 80%。

cues.text: Studies have also shown that corn, soybean and wheat farmers, could save up to 1.3 billion annually by leveraging drones to increase crop yields.
cues.en: Studies have also shown that corn, soybean and wheat farmers, could save up to 1.3 billion annually by leveraging drones to increase crop yields.
cues.zh: 研究也指出，玉米、大豆與小麥栽種者，運用無人機提升收成量，每年可節省高達 13 億美元的費用。

cues.text: Agriculture is a very traditional industry with long history.
cues.en: Agriculture is a very traditional industry with long history.
cues.zh: 農業是歷史悠久的傳統產業。

cues.text: Farmers has already have their own ways to deal with the crops, so we need to do a lot of work to convince them, to use this kind of new technology.
cues.en: Farmers has already have their own ways to deal with the crops, so we need to do a lot of work to convince them, to use this kind of new technology.
cues.zh: 農民有自己一套栽種作物的方法，因此我們要花不少功夫，說服他們使用這種新技術。

cues.text: Increasing investments into precision agriculture, are fueling the development of new platforms that integrate operators, suppliers, equipment, and data.
cues.en: Increasing investments into precision agriculture, are fueling the development of new platforms that integrate operators, suppliers, equipment, and data.
cues.zh: 精密農業的投資增加，促進了新平臺的發展，能將操作人員、供應商、裝置與資料整合在一起。 農業套裝方案採用軟體與硬體，一起提供作物防護、監測及多樣化的處理程式。

cues.text: Agricultural solution packages utilize both hardware and software to offer crop protection, monitoring, and variable treatment procedures.
cues.en: Agricultural solution packages utilize both hardware and software to offer crop protection, monitoring, and variable treatment procedures.
cues.zh: 農業套裝方案採用軟體與硬體，一起提供作物防護、監測及多樣化的處理程式。

cues.text: DJI's line of drones utilize the latest in IoT technology equipped with 12 megapixel cameras, 4K video and aerial thermal imaging.
cues.en: DJI's line of drones utilize the latest in IoT technology equipped with 12 megapixel cameras, 4K video and aerial thermal imaging.
cues.zh: DJI 的無人機系列運用最新的物聯網技術，並搭載 1200 萬畫素相機、4K 錄影及空拍熱成像技術。

cues.text: Our drone is fully automatic, what our pilot needs to do is simply type in the parameters like the speed, the spacing, the height, and then just like on the screen and then the drone can take off.
cues.en: Our drone is fully automatic, what our pilot needs to do is simply type in the parameters like the speed, the spacing, the height, and then just like on the screen and then the drone can take off.
cues.zh: 我們的無人機採全自動操作，操作員只要輸入引數，例如速度、間隔、高度，然後依螢幕指示操作，無人機就會起飛。

cues.text: To prevent potential safety risks.
cues.en: To prevent potential safety risks.
cues.zh: 避免潛在安全風險。

cues.text: Their AI systems have the ability to identify different types of landscape like trees or water, greatly improving the accuracy of maps and flight planning.
cues.en: Their AI systems have the ability to identify different types of landscape like trees or water, greatly improving the accuracy of maps and flight planning.
cues.zh: AI 系統能辨別不同的地景，例如樹木或水，因此能大幅提升地圖及飛航規劃的精確性。

cues.text: One example is an orchard mode, which uses P4R to scan and map areas based on height, shape and the number of trees.
cues.en: One example is an orchard mode, which uses P4R to scan and map areas based on height, shape and the number of trees.
cues.zh: 以果樹園為例，就採用 P4R，依據樹木的高度、形狀與數量，來掃描並繪製區域地圖。

cues.text: This allows the drone to generate flight paths for its spraying mission.
cues.en: This allows the drone to generate flight paths for its spraying mission.
cues.zh: 無人機就可依此產生飛航路徑，以進行噴灑任務。

cues.text: This intuitive mapping software allows farmers to see operation records, reports, device management, and other critical applications, DJI's ability to reach and educate farmers ensures that they have all the tools they need to tackle the challenges of the modern agricultural landscape.
cues.en: This intuitive mapping software allows farmers to see operation records, reports, device management, and other critical applications, DJI's ability to reach and educate farmers ensures that they have all the tools they need to tackle the challenges of the modern agricultural landscape.
cues.zh: 直覺的地圖軟體能讓農民檢視操作記錄、報告，進行裝置管理與其他重要應用。DJI 能向農民推廣並教育， 確保具備必要工具，因應現代化農業場域所面臨的挑戰。

cues.text: You know Digi-Key we like to use the term word enabler.
cues.en: You know Digi-Key we like to use the term word enabler.
cues.zh: 在 Digi-Key，我們很常提到促進這個詞。

cues.text: What we're trying to provide is those solution blocks to our customers for them, the engineers who have the creative ideas to do that, and that will enable these smart folks out there in the world to continue to come out with their revolutionary and then life changing designs.
cues.en: What we're trying to provide is those solution blocks to our customers for them, the engineers who have the creative ideas to do that, and that will enable these smart folks out there in the world to continue to come out with their revolutionary and then life changing designs.
cues.zh: 我們試著提供客戶成套的解決方案，以便工程師發揮創意並加以實現。如此就可促進全球有志之士，持續展開革新，提出改變生活的設計。

cues.text: Drones are just one example of how technology is redefining what it means to grow and harvest feed, in today's connected world.
cues.en: Drones are just one example of how technology is redefining what it means to grow and harvest feed, in today's connected world.
cues.zh: 無人機只是科技在當前連線世界中，重新定義食物如何栽培並收穫的一個例子。 要精進農業，就要農場大轉變。

cues.text: To farm better, we must farm different.
cues.en: To farm better, we must farm different.
cues.zh: 要精進農業，就要農場大轉變。

cues.text: In our next episode, we're traveling across the glade to Fargo, North Dakota, to see how Emerging Prairie is putting tomorrow's technology into the hands of farmers today.
cues.en: In our next episode, we're traveling across the glade to Fargo, North Dakota, to see how Emerging Prairie is putting tomorrow's technology into the hands of farmers today.
cues.zh: 在下一集中，我們將前往北達科他州法哥區，瞭解 Emerging Prairie 如何讓今日的農場經營者，運用未來的科技。
